en: Of the sons of Korach, a song, a psalm; its foundation is in the holy mountains.

he: אֹהֵ֣ב יְ֭הֹוָה שַׁעֲרֵ֣י צִיּ֑וֹן מִ֝כֹּ֗ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
en: Havayah loves the gates of Tzion, more than all the dwellings of Yackov.

he: נִ֭כְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּ֣ר בָּ֑ךְ עִ֖יר הָאֱלֹהִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃
en: Glorious things are spoken of you, city of Elokim, selah.

he: אַזְכִּ֤יר ׀ רַ֥הַב וּבָבֶ֗ל לְֽיֹ֫דְעָ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה פְלֶ֣שֶׁת וְצֹ֣ר עִם־כּ֑וּשׁ זֶ֝֗ה יֻלַּד־שָֽׁם׃
en: I shall mention Rahav and Bavel to those who know Me: behold Peleshet and Tzor with Kush — this one was born there.

he: וּ֥לְצִיּ֨וֹן ׀ יֵאָמַ֗ר אִ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִישׁ יֻלַּד־בָּ֑הּ וְה֖וּא יְכוֹנְנֶ֣הָ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
en: And of Tzion it shall be said: man and man was born in her, and He, the Most High, shall establish her.

he: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה יִ֭סְפֹּר בִּכְת֣וֹב עַמִּ֑ים זֶ֖ה יֻלַּד־שָׁ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
en: Havayah shall count when He writes the peoples: this one was born there, selah.
And singers, like dancers — all my springs are in you. [an open section break]
